name: PointCrow
noteEs: Especialista en challenge runs creativos: Elden Ring solo con tu Spirit Ash, sin levear, con un solo arma, etc. Los videos están bien editados, narran el proceso con entretenimiento real y dan ideas para tus propias self-imposed restrictions.
noteEn: Specialist in creative challenge runs: Elden Ring with only your Spirit Ash, no leveling, single weapon, etc. Videos are well edited, narrate the process with real entertainment, and give ideas for your own self-imposed restrictions.
highlightsEs: Challenge runs originales que no copian formats existentes
Streams en Twitch donde se ven los attempts reales detrás de los highlights del YouTube
Cobertura de Shadow of the Erdtree con runs sobre Promised Consort Radahn
Edición que comunica las stakes — sabes por qué cada attempt importa
Community engagement fuerte; los viewers proponen los próximos challenges
highlightsEn: Original challenge runs that don't copy existing formats
Twitch streams where you see real attempts behind YouTube highlights
Shadow of the Erdtree coverage with runs against Promised Consort Radahn
Editing that communicates the stakes — you know why each attempt matters
Strong community engagement; viewers propose the next challenges
